title: ArgumentAssemblySchema
description: Schema for first-class Argument Assembly intermediate representation between paragraph ledgers and staged prose.

unit_id.description: Identifier for the argumentative unit or paragraph (e.g., P01, UNIT_INTRO_01).

argumentative_job.description: The precise argumentative function this unit performs in the manuscript spine.

reason_for_inclusion.description: Why the broader paper narrative requires this unit here.

incoming_dependency.description: Units, claims, or contracts that must be established prior to this unit.

opening_move.description: The rhetorical and conceptual entry point of the paragraph.

foreground_claims.description: Primary substantive claims emphasized in this unit.

internal_claim_order.description: Ordered sequence of slot IDs or proposition keys (e.g., S1, S2, S3).

cross_literature_weave_decisions.description: Explicit decisions permitting interweaving across distinct literatures under an adjudicated hinge.

do_not_weave_boundaries.description: Explicit boundaries prohibiting the blending of distinct traditions or claims lacking an adjudicated hinge.

citation_choreography.description: Instructions for positioning citations without creating unearned joint claims.

source_ownership_boundaries.description: Rules attributing concepts to external literature vs internal methodology vs current manuscript.

required_qualifications.description: Necessary caveats, empirical scope limits, or theoretical conditions that must accompany claims.

terminology_to_preserve.description: Exact technical or author-specific terms that must not be paraphrased away.

terms_to_avoid.description: Misleading, conflating, or overclaiming terms forbidden in this unit.

transition_from_previous.description: How this unit bridges from the preceding argumentative unit.

exit_transition_forward.description: How this unit exits into the subsequent unit.

rhetorical_pressure_point.description: The exact conceptual tension or critical distinction that must be resolved clearly.

expected_density.description: Target analytical density and proportional length.

natural_prose_risk_flags.description: Known risks (e.g. topic-sentence monotony, false equivalence, metadiscourse leakage).

prohibited_stronger_argument.description: The strong, illicit claim that this argument must explicitly refrain from making.

evidence_lock_references.description: References to locked paragraph ledgers, cluster notes, or citation contracts.

human_status.description: Human sovereignty status of this argument assembly unit.
